question: What are the top 5 product categories (English names) by revenue?
sql:
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id
    FROM orders o
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
order_revenue AS (
    SELECT oi.order_id,
           (oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS revenue,
           oi.product_id
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN delivered_orders d ON oi.order_id = d.order_id
),
category_rev AS (
    SELECT ct.product_category_name_english AS category,
           SUM(orv.revenue) AS total_revenue
    FROM order_revenue orv
    JOIN products p ON orv.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN category_translation ct ON p.product_category_name = ct.product_category_name
    GROUP BY ct.product_category_name_english
)
SELECT category, total_revenue
FROM category_rev
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5
plan: • Identify delivered orders (order_status = 'delivered') from orders table. • Join order_items to orders on order_id to get price and freight_value for each item. • Compute revenue per item as price + freight_value. • Join order_items to products on product_id to get product_category_name. • Join product_category_name to category_translation to obtain the English category name. • Aggregate revenue by English category name, summing the item revenues. • Order the results by summed revenue descending and limit to the top 5 rows.
